rationale: Eric's work on realtime AI avatar foundation models at North Model Labs sits at the intersection of consumer AI and ML research, while Asawaree brings hands-on ML infrastructure expertise from Nvidia and foundational skills in Python and C. They could explore how Nvidia's infrastructure and tooling can optimize NML's model performance and deployment pipeline.
intro_message: Eric Sheen, meet Asawaree Bhide — Asawaree's background in ML infrastructure at Nvidia could offer valuable perspective on optimizing realtime performance for your avatar foundation models.
